verdict.rationale: Mastra documents a first-party Memory feature. It lets agents remember messages, replies and tool results across interactions and recall information from previous interactions, and agents can be configured to store message history. The evidence does not show memory spanning multiple threads; it only mentions sharing one thread between users. Persistence across sessions is implied rather than explicitly documented. Missing for 10: explicit cross-thread memory (e.g. user- or resource-scoped long-term recall), documented persistent storage backends for memory, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can give agents long-term memory that persists across sessions and threads

citations.quote: Memory enables your agent to remember user messages and agent replies, and tool results across interactions
The agent can use this context to answer follow-up questions and recall information from previous interactions.
Mastra agents can be configured to store message history.
Multi-user threads: Share one thread between multiple users.
